provenance.description: The `validation_performance` block emitted by out_of_sample_validation BEFORE the val_n_periods -> val_n_observations rename. Captured from the pre-rename source so the rename can be pinned as a key rename and nothing else.
provenance.source_note: The pre-rename commit (6074e3b4ac9a6591e5694c8a1dd8d4f0c8989e21, the one the matching test_performance baseline was captured from) is not reachable in this repository's history, so this baseline was captured from the CURRENT source with the rename reverted in the recording only: the block is written under the pre-rename key name `val_n_periods` with the value the current source emits for it (`len(val_returns)`). Its purpose is to pin that the rename moved nothing but the key NAME -- the value under the old name must equal the value under the new name, and every other key and value must be unchanged.
provenance.captured_with: out_of_sample_validation, same data / grid / split / deflation as the test_performance baseline
